note: The Citizenship Act 1977 counts Tokelau as part of New Zealand (s. 2), so its people are New Zealand citizens, and New Zealand's rules on naturalisation and on keeping citizenship are theirs.

sources.title: New Zealand Legislation, Citizenship Act 1977, section 2 (Interpretation)
sources.said: New Zealand includes the Cook Islands, Niue, Tokelau, and the Ross Dependency
